doc.lag_28/35/42: Sales 28/35/42 days earlier (same weekday). Known at forecast time for all 28 horizon days.
doc.roll_mean_7/28, roll_std_28, roll_zero_s: Rolling stats of sales shifted by 28 days: recent level, volatility, intermittency.
doc.sell_price, price_ratio: Planned price and price vs its recent average. Prices are set by the retailer ahead of time.
doc.dow, wday, month, day_of_month, week_of_: Calendar facts, always known in advance.
doc.event_flag, snap: Holiday/event and SNAP food-stamp days from the calendar, published in advance.
doc.*_code: Integer codes for store, item, category, department (fixed identifiers, not derived from sales).
